en.t: The date for the picture contest was decided.

units.source_text: 时间虽然匆促，却布置得十分精致而风雅。

en.t: Although time was short, the arrangements were made with great refinement and elegance.

units.source_text: 左右两方的画都送上来。

en.t: The paintings from both the left and right sides were brought forward.

units.source_text: 在清凉殿旁宫女们的值事房中临时设一玉座，玉座北侧为左方，南侧为右方。

en.t: A temporary imperial seat was set up in the ladies' duty room beside the Seiryo-den, with the north side of the seat assigned to the Left and the south side to the Right.

units.source_text: 其余许可上殿的人，都坐在后凉殿的廊上，各自袒护一方。

en.t: The others who were permitted to enter the palace all sat on the veranda of the Koryo-den, each favoring one side.

units.source_text: 左方的画放在一只紫檀箱中，搁在一个苏枋木的雕花的台座上。

en.t: The Left's paintings were placed in a rosewood box and set on a carved sappanwood stand.

units.source_text: 上面铺的是紫地中国织锦，下面铺的是红褐色中国绫绸。

en.t: Above it was spread Chinese brocade on a purple ground, and beneath it Chinese figured silk in a reddish brown.

units.source_text: 当差童女六人，身穿红色上衣和白色汗袗，里面衬的衫子是红色的，有的人是紫色的。

en.t: The six young girls in attendance wore red outer robes and white undergarments, with inner gowns of red, or in some cases purple.

units.source_text: 相貌与神情都矫矫不群。

en.t: Their looks and bearing were all strikingly distinguished.

units.source_text: 右方的画放在一只沉香木箱中，搁在一只嫩沉香木的桌台上，下面铺着蓝地的高丽织锦台布。

en.t: The Right's paintings were placed in an aloeswood box on a stand of young aloeswood, with a blue-ground Goryeo brocade cloth spread beneath it.

units.source_text: 桌台脚上扎台布的丝涤及桌台脚上的雕刻，都非常新颖。

en.t: The silk cords tying the cloth to the legs of the stand, and the carvings on the legs themselves, were all remarkably novel.

units.source_text: 童女身穿蓝色上衣和柳色汗袗，里面衬的是棣棠色的衫子。

en.t: The young girls wore blue outer robes and willow-green undergarments, with kerria-yellow gowns layered beneath.

units.source_text: 双方童女各把画箱抬到皇上面前。

en.t: The young girls from both sides each carried their painting boxes before the Emperor.

units.source_text: 皇上方面的宫女，属左方的在前，属右方的在后，服装颜色两方各不相同。

en.t: Among the ladies on the Emperor's side, those belonging to the Left stood in front and those of the Right behind, and the colors of their dress differed between the two sides.
